verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's first-party documentation in the pack never describes idle databases scaling to zero or zero-cost idle prototypes. The only mention is a 2021 beta-era community comment that cost scaled to zero. A later community comment says the hobby tier has gone, so the old anecdote cannot stand in for a documented current capability.

support.subject: As a founder, idle databases scale to zero so prototypes and side projects cost nothing while the data stays durable
